{{Quote|Will we ever get out of here?|The Mon Calamari to other prisoners|<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>}}
This '''[[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]''' was one of the many Mon Calamari prisoners taken captive by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] during the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]] and transported to an underwater cave used as a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camp. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], along with [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], managed to get inside the camp and talk to him and the other prisoners, motivating them and telling them not to lose hope.
